SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema IN ('store','warehouse','payments')
  AND (table_schema, table_name) IN (
    ('store','goods_receipts'),('store','inventory_book'),('store','pos_lines'),
    ('store','products'),('store','shelf_audits'),('store','stock_counts'),
    ('store','store_orders'),('store','store_order_lines'),('store','write_offs'),
    ('warehouse','pick_confirmations'),('warehouse','pallets'),('warehouse','shipments'),
    ('warehouse','shipping_notice_lines'),('warehouse','stock_adjustments'),
    ('warehouse','slots'),('warehouse','vehicles')
  )
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position;

sql_calls.sql: SELECT * FROM store.products ORDER BY sku;

SELECT 'daily_sales' AS src, date::text AS d, sku, units_sold::text AS v1, revenue_inr::text AS v2
FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, sku, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_offs', date::text, sku, units::text, reason
FROM store.write_offs WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT 'shelf_audit' AS src, audit_ts::text AS d, sku, status AS v1, NULL::text AS v2
FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_count', count_ts::text, sku, trigger, (book_before||' -> '||counted||' adj '||adjustment)
FROM store.stock_counts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND count_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND count_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecast', date::text, sku, (forecast_units_per_day||' sigma '||sigma||' rop '||reorder_point||' out '||order_up_to||' boh '||book_on_hand||' onord '||on_order||' ord '||ordered_units), method
FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY 1,2;
